# Yandex Direct 2.2.0

Practitioner-informed workflow hardening for real campaign analysis and optimization.

- Start from the business objective and comparable period/attribution basis before interpreting CPA/CR/CTR/CPC.
- Recompute ratios from source totals rather than averaging already-derived rates.
- Treat `RARELY_SERVED` and sparse demand as an observation-quality problem, not an automatic keyword deletion instruction.
- Allow consolidation of compatible low-volume intent only after intent/evidence review.
- Use `observation → hypothesis → check → action → effect criterion`, with success/stop/revert criteria before an experiment.
- Preserve `yandex-ai-approval/v2`, exact `preview_id`, later-turn approval, `--ack-bulk`, and `yandex-ai-execution/v1` for consequential writes.

Source methodology provenance: `artwist-polyakov/polyakov-claude-skills@f6a75133b3ad07e43991433c1d0a77f69c749f7b`.
